title: Veeva CRM Approved Email — Template Architecture and Merge Fields
summary: Veeva CRM Approved Email uses a modular template system where a main HTML document contains merge fields and references numbered content fragments. This enables MLR-compliant email composition where individual content blocks can be independently approved and assembled at send time.

template_structure.main_document: A single HTML file containing the email skeleton, styling, header/footer, personalization merge fields, and fragment insertion points. The main document controls layout and the overall email flow.
template_structure.fragments: Numbered HTML files (fragment 1 through N) containing self-contained content blocks — promotional images, call-to-action buttons, clinical data callouts, copay/access program links, or ISI sections. Each fragment is independently versionable and approvable.
template_structure.assembly: At send time, fragments are inserted into the main document at positions defined by the insertEmailFragments merge field. The range parameter controls which fragments appear in a given email variant.
template_structure.cdn_hosting: Images and assets are hosted on Veeva CDN (e.g., cdnae1.vod309.com) with unique content-addressable paths. This ensures compliance tracking and version control for all visual assets.

personalization.user_name: Inserts the sending rep name. Used in email signatures and greeting lines.
personalization.user_email_address: Inserts the sending rep email address for reply-to functionality.
personalization.user_mobile_phone: Inserts the sending rep mobile phone number.
personalization.account_last_name: Inserts the recipient HCP last name. Can include CSS class modifiers for capitalization.
personalization.account_first_name: Inserts the recipient HCP first name.

content_assembly.insert_email_fragments: Syntax: insertEmailFragments[start,end]. Inserts fragments numbered from start to end into the email body. Example: insertEmailFragments[1,7] inserts fragments 1 through 7.
content_assembly.custom_text: Syntax: customText[option1|option2|...]. Presents the sending rep with a dropdown of pre-approved text options to personalize the message. All options must be MLR-approved.

compliance.unsubscribe_product_link: Inserts a product-specific opt-out link. Required by regulation for commercial emails to HCPs.
compliance.prescribing_information_link: Link to the full Prescribing Information document. Required for any email containing efficacy or safety claims.

compliance_patterns.isi_inclusion: Important Safety Information must be included in every email that references product efficacy or clinical data. The ISI section is placed in the email body or accessible via a prominent link.
compliance_patterns.fair_balance: Promotional claims must be balanced with risk information. The template structure ensures ISI is structurally coupled to promotional content blocks.
compliance_patterns.document_tracking: Each email template has a unique document ID (e.g., US-48318) that ties back to the MLR approval record in the content management system.
compliance_patterns.fragment_independence: Fragments can be updated independently when safety labeling changes, without requiring re-approval of the entire email template.

title: Approved Email Example — BREZTRI AEROSPHERE (COPD Triple Therapy)
summary: Reference example of a Veeva CRM Approved Email for AstraZeneca BREZTRI AEROSPHERE (budesonide/glycopyrrolate/formoterol fumarate 320/18/9.6 mcg), a triple-combination ICS/LAMA/LABA for COPD maintenance treatment. Demonstrates real-world template patterns including clinical data presentation, fragment composition, and ISI integration.

product_context.generic: budesonide, glycopyrrolate, and formoterol fumarate dihydrate
product_context.indication: Maintenance treatment of COPD including chronic bronchitis and emphysema

ethos_study.patients: 8,588 patients with moderate to very severe COPD
ethos_study.primary_result: BREZTRI significantly reduced moderate/severe exacerbation rate vs LAMA/LABA (rate ratio 0.76, P<0.0001) and vs ICS/LABA (rate ratio 0.87, P=0.0027)

kronos_study.patients: 1,896 patients with moderate to very severe COPD
kronos_study.primary_result: FEV1 AUC0-4 improvement vs ICS/LABA of 116 mL (P<0.0001)

template_metrics.fragment_types: Patient access/copay program CTAs, clinical data callouts, HCP resource links

title: Approved Email Example — FASENRA (Severe Eosinophilic Asthma)
summary: Reference example of a Veeva CRM Approved Email for AstraZeneca FASENRA (benralizumab), a monoclonal antibody for severe eosinophilic asthma. Demonstrates the template pattern for biologic specialty products with eosinophil count threshold-based efficacy data.

product_context.indication: Add-on maintenance treatment of patients aged 12 years and older with severe asthma and an eosinophilic phenotype
product_context.mechanism: Anti-interleukin-5 receptor alpha monoclonal antibody that induces direct, rapid, and near-complete depletion of eosinophils via enhanced antibody-dependent cell-mediated cytotoxicity (ADCC)

sirocco_trial.key_result: Up to 51% reduction in annual exacerbation rates vs placebo in patients with baseline blood eosinophils >= 300 cells/uL

calima_trial.key_result: Consistent exacerbation rate reductions at both >= 300 cells/uL and >= 150 cells/uL eosinophil thresholds

clinical_data_presented.biomarker_stratification: Efficacy data presented by baseline blood eosinophil count thresholds (>= 150 and >= 300 cells/uL), demonstrating the importance of patient selection in biologic therapy

template_metrics.fragment_types: Diagnosis awareness, clinical characteristics resources, peer discussion videos, patient identification tools
merge_field_usage: account last name with capitalize class
template_metrics.notable_pattern: Uses CSS class on account last name merge field for automatic capitalization — demonstrates merge field styling capability

title: Veeva Approved Email — Content Customization Patterns and Fragment Architecture
summary: Analysis of customization patterns across FASENRA (US-34958) and BREZTRI (US-48318) approved email specimens. Both use a standardized section architecture (A through G) with Customizable Alternatives (CA) markup allowing rep-selected personalization within MLR-approved boundaries. Templates combine scientific and commercial CTAs in a single email, with fragment numbering enabling modular content assembly.

findings.section_architecture: Standardized sections labeled A through G: (A) Subject Lines, (B) Salutations, (C/D) Body Sentences with clinical and commercial variants, (E) Closing Options, (F) CTAs with icons/images, (G) Sign-Off/Close.
findings.customizable_alternatives: CA (Customizable Alternatives) markup throughout. BREZTRI: 23 subject line variants, 5 salutations, 7 CTA fragments, 3 closing salutations, 3 sign-offs. FASENRA: 7 subject lines, 4 salutations, 4 body text variants, 5 closing options, 9 CTAs, 9 sign-offs.
findings.cta_diversity: CTAs span both scientific (clinical data requests, study references, peer-reviewed content, KOL video links) and commercial (sample closet access, copay/access programs like BREZTRI Zero Pay $0 for 30-day supply). Both types coexist in a single template.
findings.fragment_numbering: Fragments use numbered CTA buttons linked to tracked assets. Each fragment is independently versionable and MLR-approvable.
findings.accessibility_compliance: Alt-tag accessibility tables provided for all images. Auto-populated fields include rep email, phone, and send date.
findings.subject_line_spectrum: Subject lines range from clinical tone ('New clinical data for [brand]') to commercial ('Your patients may benefit from [brand]'). Rep selects based on HCP relationship and engagement context.
findings.auto_populated_fields: Rep email address, phone number, and send date are auto-populated from CRM user profile. Reduces personalization errors and ensures compliance with sender identification requirements.

source: FASENRA (US-34958, Feb 2020) and BREZTRI (US-48318, Dec 2020) Veeva Approved Email specimens
